questions: This South African rugby lock made his international debut in 2012 and became the Springboks' most-capped player ever, racking up 141 test appearances — who is he?
Eben Etzebeth (born 29 October 1991) is a South African professional rugby union player who currently plays for the Sharks in the United Rugby Championship and the South Africa national team.
Who directed Zara Hatke Zara Bachke?
Zara Hatke Zara Bachke → Laxman Utekar. The film was written and directed by Laxman Utekar and produced by Maddock Films and Jio Studios.
In this 1989 Billy Joel song, breathless lyrics race through 119 historical events from the year of his birth to the year of its release — what is it?
We Didn't Start the Fire is a song written by American musician Billy Joel.

This membrane-bound organelle, found in plant and fungal cells and some others, is essentially a water-filled storage compartment with no fixed shape, formed when smaller membrane vesicles fuse together. What is it called?
Vacuole is a membrane-bound organelle which is present in plant and fungal cells and some protist, animal, and bacterial cells.
Emmanuelle: Fictional character. The first Emmanuelle film debuted in 1974 and starred Sylvia Kristel, who became synonymous with the role.
Which one below was established earliest?
BP (founded 1908) is the earliest of the four.

Fought between September 8–11, 9 CE, this major battle saw Germanic peoples ambush and defeat three Roman legions led by Publius Quinctilius Varus, with the Germanic alliance led by Arminius. What is it also called?
Battle of the Teutoburg Forest: Roman defeat by Germanic tribes in 9 AD.
